One simple route from file to e-reader.

  1. 1

    Connect your e-reader

    For Wi-Fi, connect both devices to the same network, open the address shown in BRIZFI in your e-reader’s browser and confirm the connection. Or choose USB.

  2. 2

    Choose your books

    Add files to the app. Prepare EPUB and FB2 for Kindle, or transfer an existing AZW3 file without conversion.

  3. 3

    Transfer and read

    With Wi-Fi, download the book from the page in your e-reader’s browser. With USB, send it from the app. Then open the book on your e-reader.

Books travel.
Privacy stays with you.

No account or cloud upload is needed to transfer a book. Conversion runs on your own device.

For Wi-Fi transfers, use a trusted local network and keep the app open until the transfer finishes.

What you need to connect ↗

Before you connect

Which e-readers are supported?

Transferring and opening test books has been verified on Kindle Basic 2024. EPUB transfer to NOOK over USB has also been verified on Windows. Other models and connection methods need separate testing.

Which file formats can I transfer?

For Kindle, EPUB and FB2 can be converted to AZW3; existing AZW3 files transfer unchanged. Supported NOOK devices use EPUB. Whether a book opens depends on the e-reader. DRM-protected books are not supported.

How do I install the Windows version?

Download and run the Windows x64 EXE installer. Choose an installation folder, then open BRIZFI from the Start menu. Administrator rights are not required. A portable ZIP is also available in the GitHub release.

Do transfers need internet access?

Local transfers do not need internet access. For Wi-Fi, both devices must share a network and the e-reader’s browser must be able to open the local page. HTTP traffic is not encrypted, so use a trusted network. Downloading the app requires internet access.
